title: Chapter 401 The Demon King Of Huangshan Falls
content:
Chapter 401 The Demon King Of Huangshan Falls

How long does it take for an ordinary monster clan to grow from a beast to a third-level cultivation base, and have a little climate? There is not enough systematic inheritance of the monster clan, coupled with the lack of intelligence, it can only be achieved after hundreds or even hundreds of years of accumulation .

Among them, there must be enough luck and a certain amount of talent to avoid dying in the middle.

Often there are only a hundred beasts with talent, and only one of them can reach the third level, and is called a monster by people.

And what about the human race?

For a dynasty with a great inheritance of this system, they have rich experience, and a talented human being can often reach the third level only after more than ten years of training, which is many times faster than the Yaozu.

And the success rate is much higher, often one out of dozens of people has the potential of Tier 3, which guarantees a huge foundation for Tier 3 powerhouses of the human race.

At certain special moments, the major dynasties can even cultivate a third-level warrior within a few years by virtue of the secret techniques they have continuously explored.

Although these quick third-order foundations are shallow, their strength can be weaker than those of the same rank. But no matter what, no matter how you say these people are also third-tier, genuine goods at a fair price, they have a natural advantage over second-tier people.

And with the advantage of a huge number of people, these can be mass-produced on the street, which is enough for the dynasty to deal with large-scale battles that consume a lot of money.

And what these dynasties need to pay is nothing more than a little bit of resources.

For them, if they can have a battle loss ratio of 1:1, 1:2, or even 1:3 on the battlefield with the Yaozu, that is a profit.

No matter how large the population of the race is, even the Ming Dynasty, which is relatively weak among the major dynasties, has a vast territory of millions of miles and a population of hundreds of millions, which can be completely consumed.

In ordinary wars, the death of hundreds of thousands of monster soldiers is nothing to the monster clan, and they can afford it.

But once the scale reaches tens of thousands, or even hundreds of millions, it will definitely shake the foundation and hurt the bones.

Although it seems for the time being, it doesn't have much impact on the strength of the entire Yaozu. But looking at it from a long-term point of view, it is a complete fault in the next area of the Yaozu, and there is no successor.

Once all the low-level third-level monsters are dead, even if there are high-level monsters above the fourth level sitting in command, the general strength will not be affected.

But when all these monsters above the fourth level die, none of the monsters at the bottom can improve their cultivation and fill in these vacancies.

Then the Yaozu will almost be able to declare their extinction by then, and all the inheritances will cut off their own strength, and they will not be able to withstand the killing and plundering of the human race. This Liaozhai world can also change its name.

Because there are no demons and only ghosts are left, it is not very appropriate to call it Liaozhai.

So it's not that the monster race doesn't want to fight a large-scale legion melee with the human race, but that they simply can't afford it.

How many monster soldiers above the third rank are there in the entire monster clan? Just look at the number of monster soldiers trained by the Huangshan Monster King for thousands of miles in the mountains and forests that have been cultivated for thousands of years, but there are only more than 30,000 people.

Moreover, the total number of monster soldiers who came to join in the entire Ming Dynasty did not exceed 100,000, which shows how shallow the foundation of the monster clan is.

After all, it was nearly a thousand years before they began to rise. How could they accumulate enough strength so quickly? They still need a longer period of time to slowly accumulate until they have the power to fight against the human race.

And that takes a long time.

Therefore, after Zhong Yu thoroughly understood the situation of the Ming Dynasty, he personally estimated that the total number of monster soldiers above the third level of the monster clan in the entire continent did not exceed ten million, and he didn't even know that there were five million Is there any, the weak ones can.

And when the entire human race is added up, it is certain that it will exceed 10 million, and it is not impossible to even exceed 100 million. Compared with the strength of the two, the gap can be seen at a glance.

This time, the monster clan's army was defeated, and the whole army was wiped out.

As the commander-in-chief of this army, the original purpose of the Huangshan Demon King was to sacrifice this army so as to disrupt the encirclement of the enemy, and then rely on his own strength to escape.

But who would have thought that these 5,000 demon soldiers would be submerged cleanly without even a bubble popping up on the battlefield.

The speed is fast enough, there is not even time for the Huangshan Demon King to react.

In the midair, a yellow figure moved slowly and disappeared in the clouds without making a sound.

"Why, Lord Demon King is here as a guest, do you want to leave without saying hello?"

Zhong Yu's playful voice made the Huangshan Demon King, who was slowly retreating in front of him, pause, and his whole body stiffened.

"It's you, the strange strong man?"

Turning his head, the Huangshan Demon King looked at the source of the voice, his expression recovered, and he was still so calm.

After all, he is a demon king, even if the situation is not good for him, he still has the calmness he should have.

"That's right, it's me. Lord Demon King came to visit me. I don't know how you feel. Is my army strong?"

Nodding his head, Zhong Yu directly agreed.

"Do you want to keep me, can you eat with a stutter?"

With a few sneers, the Huangshan Demon King's eyes flickered, his killing intent gathered in his heart, and his aura began to grow stronger.

"Whether the teeth are good or not, won't the king know if you try it?"

After Zhong Yu finished speaking, he shot out with the sword in his hand, and a monstrous blood light enveloped the surrounding ten miles, covering the entire battlefield. The bright sunlight could not penetrate except the blood cloud, and it seemed that there was only blood left between the sky and the earth.

Seeing this, the Demon King of Huangshan did not dare to be negligent, and quickly opened his mouth to spit out his magic power.

I saw endless yellow smoke pouring out of his mouth, and the smoke surged and merged and swallowed the blood cloud continuously. The two sides were entangled with each other endlessly.

"It's interesting. Is this the supernatural power you used to kill Governor Qin Ming?"

Although the yellow mist is quite powerful, it is constantly devouring and resisting the corrosion of the blood cloud, but within a mile around Zhong Yu, the extremely thick blood firmly resists the yellow mist, and cannot enter at all.

This also saved his senses from suffering from Qin Ming's suffering, and avoided some nausea.

The weasel's natal supernatural power focuses on entanglement and weakness, and it is an auxiliary power.

Encountering untargeted enemies may have miraculous effects, but against Zhong Yu, a master of the same level who has the same means, it is indeed equal to nothing, and the effect is very little.

As a result, the Huangshan Demon King, who doesn't have much combat power and has only a few magical means, has weakened more than 50% of his strength.

Zhong Yu's incomparably thick true energy poured into the blood sword, causing the blood mist to surge more and more, and the power of corrosion greatly increased. The surrounding yellow mist that was almost equivalent to the blood cloud was quickly swallowed up, and the blood mist also began to wrap around the body of the Huangshan Demon King.

"It's over, the Huangshan Demon King who was raging for a while, your myth will be terminated by me at this moment, and with your corpse, I will embark on infinite glory!"

Zhong Yu murmured a few words in a low voice, which was regarded as a tribute to the Huangshan Demon King who once dominated the side in front of him.

As soon as the blood sword moved, it left Zhong Yu's palm in an instant, and under the command of his wish, it crossed the distance of space and appeared directly in front of the Yellow Mountain Demon King.

Countless sword lights crisscrossed, and the Huangshan Demon King was completely turned into fly ash and fell.

Since then, the overlord Huangshan Demon King suddenly collapsed, and the four eastern counties of Dongjiang Province ushered in a new master.
